WAGR-441 (In Progress, Kobi) names WAGR-46 as a dependency, and its AC 4 owns the end-to-end retest ('last test was on a few records, before the SLC and API changes'). q1: Found. Re-fetched both docs from Drive (text/html, decoded, converted). Doc 1Qw_rUiB... (2026-08-11) lines 209-211 at 00:06:08: Kobi's 'survey completion for the test integration that uh uh Strad did ... it did come through', Emily's 'Not after you like unblocked him this last whatnot', and Kobi's 'survey completion uh check box and the dates are filled in. So it looks like it's good' are verbatim, with the ellipses only removing text. Doc 14qj2c7X... (2026-09-23) line 280 at 00:05:06: the quote is verbatim. The L2908 quote is at lines 323-327. Kobi's line is at 00:08:39, and Emily's 'Perfect. Can we do that this week?' plus Kobi's 'fields up and running like today' come after the 00:09:51 marker. This is a minor timestamp span issue, and the wording is exact.
q2: Supports the claim in context, with qualifications. On 08-11 Kobi saw one record ('the only one that I saw') updated by the integration user, and he could not see the call payload. So 'tested' means one smoke-test record, not a full test. On 09-23 (line 306) Kobi said 'Let's test both to make sure that that's still working because I know we've made quite a bit of changes to the SLC process and the API calls since the initial test'. This confirms that a retest is needed and that the August test may be out of date. The CMS sender is owned by WagerTech (WAGR-46 description: 'Owner: Wagertech (Joyce's team)'). So 'the callout was built' refers mainly to WagerTech's build, and the SF side is small (Size XS). The claim says the field contract was 'replaced'. WAGR-441 says it 'extends its contract to two surveys', so 'replaced' is a slight overstatement.
q3: No later reversal. The ledger has no survey rows after 2026-09-23 (the latest rows are L2904-L2910, L2981, L2982 and L2989, all dated 09-23). A grep of the raw transcripts from 09-24 to 09-30 (internal syncs on 09-24, 09-25 and 09-28, the referral/payouts discovery, the operator markets call, the Kobi-Cedrick CMS walkthrough on 09-29 and the 09-30 weekly sync) finds only the Gemini 'take a short survey' boilerplate. There was no new discussion of survey completion.
q4: Partially covered. WAGR-46 live: workflow status Requirements, assignee none, last updated 2026-09-14, 1 comment (2026-08-10, no author shown): 'Provided updated fields to Emily/Strah and sits with Wagertech to test and confirm this works.' The custom field 'Status' (customfield_10234) = 'Awaiting Client Feedback', Phase 1, MoSCoW Should Have, Size XS, no issue links. So the ticket already shows 'built, waiting on the client to test' in a secondary field, which weakens the 'board shows survey completion as unstarted' framing. WAGR-441 live: In Progress, Kobi Kunasekaran, 1 comment (2026-09-25: Survey 1 relabel done, Survey 2 fields created, Emily notified; next step is to confirm that Strah can update the fields through the CMS). Its description lists WAGR-46 as a dependency, and AC 4 owns the retest of both paths in the sandbox. JQL 'project = WAGR AND text ~ "survey"' returned WAGR-441, WAGR-401 (Jumpr Review, Taryn), WAGR-432, WAGR-319, WAGR-266, WAGR-29, WAGR-6 and WAGR-46. No separate retest or supersession ticket exists, and WAGR-46 and WAGR-441 have no formal issue link.
corrections: WAGR-46 has the custom field 'Status' = 'Awaiting Client Feedback' (customfield_10234). The variance should mention this, because it partly contradicts 'board does not show survey completion as unstarted'.
The 08-11 'test' was one record seen updated by the integration user, not a broader test.
WAGR-441 'extends' the WAGR-46 contract to two surveys. It does not 'replace' it.
The L2908 quote spans timestamps 00:08:39 to 00:09:51 (the Emily and Kobi follow-up lines come after 00:09:51).
Suggested action refinement: add a formal issue link between WAGR-46 and WAGR-441 (none exists today), and align the workflow status with the custom Status field.
